localDoulas.name: MotheRetreat
localDoulas.description: MotheRetreat provides birth doula support to families across Fort Lauderdale and the Broward coast, offering continuous one-on-one care through labor and close coordination with your medical team. Ask directly about current availability, package details, and backup coverage when you book your consultation.

localDoulas.name: Amber Marie
localDoulas.description: Amber Marie of Hummingbird Birth is a certified birth and postpartum doula with more than 20 years of experience supporting families in South Florida. Her birth support package includes two prenatal visits, continuous labor care, and four weeks of postpartum phone support.

localDoulas.name: Martha
localDoulas.description: Martha of zenmamalove is a certified doula, birth assistant, and photographer serving Fort Lauderdale, Boca Raton, and Broward County. She offers hands-on labor support alongside documentary-style birth photography for families who want both care and keepsakes.

localDoulas.name: Serene Gato
localDoulas.description: Serene Gato of A Serene Birth is an experienced birth doula serving Broward County with physical, emotional, and advocacy support before, during, and immediately after birth. She helps partners participate with confidence and explains options clearly when the medical team proposes interventions.
